observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: spacious hall with marble floors, pillars, large staircase, and multiple crystal chandeliers
observation.formation_and_space: solo dancer moving freely across the center of the hall
observation.posture: upright torso, soft knees, weight shifting across feet
observation.footwork: fast turning steps, foot pacing, side steps synchronized to the rhythm
observation.arms_and_hands: arms gesturing gracefully, hands holding or adjusting veil, twirling with flowing arm movements
observation.hips_and_torso: fluid hip and torso rotation during spins and turns
observation.levels_jumps_turns: continuous fast spins and turns, ending in a low floor drop

twirling in place with one arm extended high and upper body arching
fast synchronized spins leading into a dramatic drop to the floor
